ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aastha Spintex Limited announced several governance and operational changes, including the appointment of Mr. Utsav Himanshu Trivedi as a new Non-Executive Independent Director, replacing Mr. Anant Bharatbhai Bhatt who resigned due to pre-occupation and personal commitments. The company also appointed new Statutory and Secretarial Auditors, with the statutory auditor change being a routine replacement due to term expiry. Additionally, the Board fixed a record date for the payment of a final dividend, signalling planned returns to shareholders.
